hypotheses.title: Batch 81: Tri-Candidate Decorrelation Push (Targeting Alphas 27, 28, & 29)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Directly resolves the remaining self-correlation margins from Batch 80 and deploys Playbook operating leverage: (1) Candidate 1: Shaves off the 0.0057 self-correlation margin on the 1.71 Sharpe SUE engine (c35563db) by shifting to 126-day SUE lookback and 10-day delta timing in TOP2000 Subindustry Neutral (Decay 6). (2) Candidate 2: Implements Operating Leverage & 120-Day Margin Expansion (Playbook H05) in TOP1000 Subindustry Neutral. (3) Candidate 3: Ports the 1.65 Sub-universe Sharpe LEAP Call Term Structure engine into TOP1000 Industry Neutral to break correlation against TOPSP500 Alpha 24.
hypotheses.falsification_test: Alpha fails if 126-day SUE surprise or 120-day margin expansion deteriorates under subindustry neutralization.

candidates.rationale: Candidate 1 (Decorrelated SUE Earnings Surprise Drift): Uses 126-day SUE lookback and 10-day delta timing in TOP2000 Subindustry Neutral with Decay 6 to clear the 0.70 self-correlation threshold against Alpha 26 and elevate Fitness >= 1.50.
